title: Add Ocarina Studio carousel to Marketplace page, replacing the search bar

requirements.text: Update the Marketplace page (frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx) to remove the search bar and replace it with a horizontally scrollable carousel/slideshow at the top of the page. The carousel must reuse the same studio card layout from OcarinaStudio.tsx, displaying products fetched via the existing useProducts React Query hook. Each card in the carousel must show the product image, title, description, and assigned pitch scale, and include three interactive controls: a 'Play Demo' button (triggers the ocarinaSynth demo tone sequence for the card's pitch scale), a 'Play Ocarina' button (opens the interactive OcarinaPanel for the card's pitch scale), and a 'Buy Now' link that navigates to the marketplace product detail view for that product.

quotes: 1 marketplace. 2 copy the Studio page displays product cards. 3 still link to play demo, play ocarina and buy now

acceptanceCriteria: The search bar is removed from the Marketplace page.
A horizontally scrollable carousel appears at the top of the Marketplace page, in the position previously occupied by the search bar.
The carousel renders product cards using the same visual layout as the OcarinaStudio page studio cards.
Each carousel card displays the product image, title, description, and assigned pitch scale.
Clicking 'Play Demo' on a carousel card plays the ocarinaSynth demo tone sequence for that card's assigned pitch scale, with a visual playing indicator while the demo runs.
Clicking 'Play Ocarina' on a carousel card opens the interactive OcarinaPanel modal/inline panel for that card's assigned pitch scale, allowing individual notes to be played.
The OcarinaPanel includes a close/dismiss control.
Clicking 'Buy Now' on a carousel card navigates to the product detail view for that product (same behaviour as on the OcarinaStudio page).
Products displayed in the carousel are fetched from the backend using the existing useProducts hook and update automatically when new products are added.
The carousel is responsive and does not break the page layout on desktop or mobile viewports.
All remaining Marketplace page content (hero section, filter tabs, product sections) remains intact and functional below the carousel.

constraints: Do not modify files listed under frontend.immutablePaths.
Reuse the existing OcarinaPanel component and ocarinaSynth utility; do not duplicate their logic.
The existing pitch-scale assignment logic from OcarinaStudio.tsx must be applied consistently in the carousel.
All other Marketplace page sections (hero, shape/category filters, featured/most-viewed/best-selling/newest product sections) must remain unchanged.
nonGoals: Adding a new backend endpoint or changing backend data structures.
Adding pagination or infinite scroll to the carousel.
Changing the shape/category filter tabs or any other Marketplace section.
